'''Jaizec Lottie''' (born February 16, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Start Lublin]] of the [[Polish Basketball League]] (PLK).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Jaizec-Lottie/Summary/105816|title=Jaizec Lottie Player Profile, VEF Riga – RealGM|website=basketball.realgm.com}}</ref> Standing at a height of {{height|ft=6|in=2}}, he plays the [[point guard]] position.

==Professional career==
After graduating, Lottie signed his first pro contract in [[Switzerland]] to become the starting point guard for team [[BBC Monthey-Chablais]].<ref>[https://bbcmc.ch/2022/06/welcome-jaizec Welcome JAIZEC]</ref> In the summer of 2023, Jaizec played for [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in [[2023 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]].<ref>[https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-announce-nba-2k24-nba-summer-league-2023-roster Trail Blazers Announce NBA 2K24 NBA Summer League 2023 Roster]</ref>

On July 23, 2023, Lottie signed with [[Scafati Basket|Givova Scafati]] in [[Lega Basket Serie A]].<ref>[https://www.eurobasket.com/Italy/news/820298/Jaizec-Lottie-is-a-newcomer-at-Scafati Jaizec Lottie is a newcomer at Scafati]</ref> After appearing in 4 games, he left Scafati and joined [[BK VEF Rīga|VEF Rīga]].<ref>[https://www.eurobasket.com/Lat-Est-BL/news/836005/VEF-Riga-adds-Lottie-to-their-roster-ex-Scafati VEF Riga adds Lottie to their roster, ex Scafati]</ref>

On July 17, 2024, he signed with [[Hamburg Towers]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hamburgtowers.de/news/neuer-lenker-vom-lettischen-double-sieger/|title=Neuer Lenker vom lettischen Double-Sieger|last=|first=|date=July 17, 2024|website=hamburgtowers.de|publisher=|language=de|access-date=September 25, 2024}}</ref>

On July 27, 2026, he signed with [[Start Lublin]] of the [[Polish Basketball League]] (PLK).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.startlublin.pl/aktualnosci/jaizec-lottie-w-pge-starcie-lublin|title=Jaizec Lottie w PGE Starcie Lublin|last=|first=|date=July 27, 2026|website=startlublin.pl|publisher=|language=pl|access-date=August 31, 2026}}</ref>
